analysis.title: How can I position for equity upside?
key_insights: UBS CIO's House View is to stay invested through diversified exposure to cyclical and structural growth opportunities and to use market strength to reduce concentrated single-stock positions.
Higher rates and energy costs warrant selectivity, but UBS does not see them as justifying a broadly defensive stance.
AI-related stocks have been volatile in recent weeks, but equity market fundamentals remain solid, with resilient earnings and economic activity.
UBS sees AI as a structural investment opportunity. Risks are rising in the more capital-intensive parts of the AI buildout, where funding pressures and execution risks could reinforce each other.
Broader AI demand is robust, shown by accelerating cloud growth and rising GPU rental prices.
UBS forecasts aggregate AI capex of USD 1tr in 2026, USD 1.4tr in 2027 and USD 1.5tr in 2028.
Concentrated market performance makes diversification important. A narrowly concentrated equity portfolio is more exposed to company-specific setbacks.

A robust US economy, solid labor market, strong credit creation and continued fiscal support should support earnings outside the AI complex. Robust earnings growth outside the US widens the opportunity set for global investors.
Preferred US sectors are consumer discretionary, financials, health care, industrials and utilities.
UBS is positive on Eurozone equities and favors banks, consumer discretionary, health care, industrials, IT and Germany. It forecasts 15% earnings growth in Europe in both 2026 and 2027.
In Asia, equity valuations are at multi-decade lows and AI investment trends remain intact, supporting a robust earnings outlook.
The S&P 500 rose 2.5% last week after a 2.7% decline the week before, as tech stocks regained ground. European equities also rallied on strong third-quarter earnings.
US tech stocks fell in early November as investors reassessed what Democratic gains in the US midterm elections, especially at state level, mean for AI infrastructure and data centers.
Investors with concentrated mega-cap tech positions can use rallies to rebalance into structured strategies that offer some capital preservation.

trade_ideas.description: Rebalance concentrated mega-cap tech positions into structured strategies with a degree of capital preservation, using rallies.

Concentration of market performance in a narrow set of stocks, which increases exposure to company-specific setbacks.

vol_and_positioning: Investors with concentrated mega-cap tech positions can use rallies to rebalance into structured strategies that offer a degree of capital preservation.
UBS suggests considering capital preservation strategies where drawdown tolerance is limited.
